schemes.name: Warm Home Discount
schemes.gives: £150 off your electricity bill this winter.
schemes.how: It's usually automatic and a letter arrives between late October and early January. Your name or your partner's needs to be on the electricity bill.
schemes.timing: No letter by early January? Contact the scheme.

rule.expr: lives in England, Scotland or Wales
rule.txt: Lives in England, Scotland or Wales
rule.fail: Northern Ireland has the Affordable Warmth scheme instead

rule.expr: gets Universal Credit or Pension Credit
rule.txt: Gets Universal Credit or Pension Credit
rule.fail: Needs Universal Credit or Pension Credit

sco.how: In Scotland you may need to ask your electricity supplier for it, so contact them this winter.

schemes.name: Broadband social tariff
schemes.gives: The same home broadband or a mobile plan for about £10 to £25 a month.
schemes.how: Ask your provider for its social tariff, or switch to one that has one. Ask about exit fees first. The person getting the benefit needs to be the main name on the contract.

rule.expr: gets Universal Credit or Pension Credit
rule.txt: Gets Universal Credit or Pension Credit
rule.fail: Needs Universal Credit or Pension Credit

schemes.name: Priority Services Register
schemes.gives: Free extra support with gas and electricity, like a warning before a planned power cut.
schemes.how: Ask your energy supplier to add you, online or by phone. If gas and electricity come from different suppliers, ask each one, and ask again if you switch.

rule.expr: lives in England, Scotland or Wales
rule.txt: Lives in England, Scotland or Wales
rule.fail: Northern Ireland runs its own register: ask your electricity supplier

rule.expr: pension age, a child under 5, pregnant, or a health need
rule.txt: Pension age, a young child, pregnancy or a health need
rule.fail: None of the usual reasons apply yet. Ask if things change.

clashes.text: The Warm Home Discount doesn't lower a Cold Weather Payment or Winter Fuel Payment. You can get them all.
